forcedChoices.reason: The text speaks to the readers as a group (packet rule: plural ustedes).
Orden as a classification of beings, not a religious order.

forcedChoices.choice: el último gran esfuerzo de fe
forcedChoices.reason: 'stretch of faith' reads as an exertion of faith; Spanish has no word that keeps both the effort and the span senses.

forcedChoices.choice: su nombre es el espíritu de ustedes
forcedChoices.reason: Plain 'su espíritu' would be ambiguous between his and your; the English says 'your'.
English 'his' is generic; Spanish keeps the generic form without a gender mark on the verb.
Glossary form for 'the Ultimate' is 'el Último'; Spanish forces a gender where 'lo Último' would be impersonal.
'certain' paired with 'lasting' reads as 'sure'; 'cierta satisfacción' would mean 'some satisfaction'.
'child' has no gender in English; Spanish needs one, and the masculine generic matches 'Creator Father'.
